title: RuntimeErrorToProcessFailedEvents
description: Message sent to the failed-events SQS queue, read by job-failed, for a failure one of our Lambdas recognises: a permanent error in process-summary, process-issues or setup-project, or a stale job found by check-stale-jobs. The same queue also carries the Lambda service's on-failure records (service_error_to_process_failed_events). It never holds summary text, invocation payloads or raw error messages.

id.description: The job ID; for setup-project, which has no job, the asynchronous invocation's request ID.

reason.description: A short code without whitespace, e.g. github_forbidden, generation_failed or stale_received.

channel_id.description: The Slack channel to tell about the failure.

thread_ts.description: The thread to reply in, if known; otherwise absent or null.
